lead.headline: Strange and the Jaguars are free this morning, and Pickens is on waivers
lead.deck: Your tight-end slot still projects zero and Tuten is still on the bench. Everything Tuesday's brief waited for cleared. One claim is worth making before 01:00 Thursday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Saquon Barkley still has no ruling; Nick Sirianni's promised update is today and had not come by 07:00. Your tight-end slot still projects 0.0 because Darren Waller is on bye, your defence is still the Ravens at 4.9, and Bhayshul Tuten, 3.1 above Ollie Gordon, is still on the bench. You are 0–4 and ESPN gives you 39% as set. The good news is that waiting worked. Nobody claimed a tight end or a defence overnight, and you moved up to 7th in the order by standing still. Brenton Strange, Colston Loveland, T.J. Hockenson, the Jaguars and the Cowboys are all free agents. Add Strange for Waller today. Tuesday's doubt about him was whether an injury explained his eight targets; it doesn't. Every Jacksonville pass-catcher was healthy, and he led all tight ends in yards per route. The seat is Waller's, which bends two of this brief's own rules, and the card says which. Then swap the Ravens for the Jaguars: Philadelphia put Tank Bigsby on injured reserve, lost Lane Johnson to retirement, and are without DeVonta Smith. One thing is new. At 02:07 KEI returns dropped George Pickens to claim Romeo Doubs. Pickens plays 83% of Dallas's snaps and has 28 targets in four games, and he is on waivers until 01:00 on Thursday. I would put in a claim and name Josh Downs as the drop. You are 7th of ten, so it will probably fail, and a failed claim costs nothing. If it wins it costs three places. Neither of this system's wire tools found him; the activity log did. Leave Will Shipley alone unless Barkley is ruled out past London. With the two adds and Tuten you project about 118 to Kings of the North's 123.
